_meta.semantics: decision_mode removed from the forwarded payload; envelope = passthroughEnvelope (decided_by repair-passthrough, confidence 1, stripped_prompt verbatim); x-decision-mode: chart. For 'chart' MODE_SKILL is null but MODE_CONTRACTS[chart] exists -> a decision_skill block with ONLY the mode contract is injected (no core_skill).
_meta.normalization: Stage-event "ms" timing values replaced with "<ms>" in logicalFrames; progress-path response bodies are stored ms-normalized (raw bytes carry volatile ms digits).
